quizName: Sign Test Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a side road is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a school zone is ahead or nearby. Watch for children and follow the posted speed limits.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that an intersection is coming up so you can prepare to turn or slow down.

questions.question: You see this sign for a railroad crossing with no signal. What should you do?

options.text: Keep your speed and look and listen for trains.
Slow down, look both ways, listen for trains, and be ready to stop if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, look both ways, listen for trains, and be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing without signals, slow down, look both ways, and listen for trains. Be ready to stop if a train is coming. Never try to outrun a train.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane ends or road narrows ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane ends or road narrows ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that a lane is ending or the road is getting narrower ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you a stop sign is coming up. Get ready to stop completely before going forward.

questions.question: What type of sign is this?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black markings or symbols. They warn you about special situations or hazards ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: No trucks are allowed on the upcoming hill.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you about a steep hill coming up. Slow down and be ready to control your speed to protect your brakes.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: No trucks are allowed on an upcoming hill.
Trucks are on an upcoming hill.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill or downgrade is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a 35 mph speed zone after the curve.
Drive at least 35 mph around the upcoming curve.
Slow down to 35 mph or less before the upcoming curve.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down to 35 mph or less before the upcoming curve.
questions.explanation: Yellow diamond signs warn you about road conditions ahead. Speed advisory signs tell you the safe speed for upcoming curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A group is picking up trash along the highway ahead.
Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that workers may be on or near the road ahead. Drive carefully through this area.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you must:

options.text: Stop completely and look for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and look for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs are stop signs. You must stop completely, check for pedestrians and oncoming traffic, and wait for the intersection to be clear before going.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers to yield to oncoming traffic when turning left on a green light. Complete the turn only when it is safe.

questions.question: At a school crossing sign, you should:

options.text: Always stop, even if there is no stop sign.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk your horn when you see children.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Pentagon-shaped signs mark school zones and crossings. When you see these signs, stay alert and be prepared to stop.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a four-way intersection is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers on or near the road.

questions.explanation: Yellow diamond signs with black markings warn of hazards ahead. This sign alerts drivers that pedestrians may be crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits right turns.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the road is clear.
Come to a complete stop before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: If you pass this sign, you are going the wrong way and risk a head-on crash. Turn around carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means left turns are not allowed. It is unsafe and against the law to turn left where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: One lane is ending. Move to the left.
A highway entrance ramp is ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: One lane is ending. Move to the left.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign tells drivers that a lane is ending and traffic must move left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this location. It is illegal and unsafe to turn right where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: How high the space is under a bridge or overpass.
The tallest vehicle allowed in this state.
The widest vehicle allowed on the highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: How high the space is under a bridge or overpass.
questions.explanation: This warning sign shows the height from the road to the bottom of a bridge or overpass. In this case, it is 12 feet 6 inches.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You cannot turn around and go the opposite direction at this location.

questions.question: What type of sign is this?
questions.explanation: A downward-pointing triangle is always a yield sign. You must be ready to slow down or stop when you see it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings tell you about conditions ahead. This sign warns you that you are leaving a one-way road and will soon drive on a road with traffic going both ways.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must stop for workers directing traffic.
The road ahead has construction or maintenance work.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead has construction or maintenance work.
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers of work zones. Slow down and drive carefully when you see these signs.

questions.question: What information do blue traffic signs provide?
questions.explanation: Blue signs tell you about services for drivers. They show locations of rest areas, food, gas, hospitals, and other helpful services.

questions.question: What does an orange and red triangle on a vehicle always mean?
questions.explanation: Slow vehicles like farm tractors, road maintenance trucks, and horse-drawn carts display an orange and red triangle on the back.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Three-sided signs tell you to slow down at an intersection. Be ready to stop and let other drivers and pedestrians go first. You may continue when it is safe.

questions.question: This is the shape and color of a __________ sign.
questions.explanation: Triangular signs pointing down mean you must yield. Slow down to a safe speed and stop if needed. Stop at a marked line if one exists.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road turns sharply to the right and then sharply to the left.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign means traffic is merging from the right. Be ready to let other vehicles safely join your lane.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign warns that traffic is merging from the right. Be ready to let other vehicles merge safely into your lane.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you:

options.text: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
Will always stop at the upcoming railroad crossing.
Should stop and wait for a signal before crossing the railroad tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
questions.explanation: This sign means a railroad crossing is ahead. Look and listen, slow down, and be ready to stop. Wait for any trains to pass before crossing.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must and must not do. This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: You should stop for other traffic.
Traffic is entering from another road and you should allow additional space for drivers to merge safely into the flow of traffic.
Traffic is entering from another road and you should keep right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is entering from another road and you should allow additional space for drivers to merge safely into the flow of traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic is merging from another road. Check your side and rear mirrors, then move to another lane if you can to give merging drivers room to safely join traffic.

questions.question: This sign is used to warn drivers about:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you to an upcoming curve to the right.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign means your road crosses a divided highway. A divided highway has two separate one-way roads with a median or barrier between them.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic is entering from the right.

questions.question: What do orange background signs mean?
questions.explanation: Orange is used only for construction and maintenance warning signs.

questions.question: What is the correct order of traffic lights from top to bottom?
questions.explanation: Red is always on top and green on the bottom. When traffic lights are arranged horizontally, red is always on the left and green on the right.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means a divided highway is ahead. The road splits into two one-way roadways separated by a median. You must keep to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a crossroad is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a school crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
Specific turning movements are allowed from specific lanes.
Drivers in both lanes are responsible for merging smoothly.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane. It is reserved for buses and vehicles with a driver and one or more passengers as shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to stop.
You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: The stop sign is the only eight-sided sign on the road. You must come to a complete stop. Do not move until it is safe and clear for you to pass through the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow and black. They alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign tells you a lane is ending and you should prepare to merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. This sign tells you a traffic signal is ahead so you can prepare to stop.

questions.question: What does a green arrow on a lane control signal mean?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A green arrow pointing down over a lane means you may use that lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell drivers about upcoming road conditions. This sign warns you that the road curves ahead. Slow down and be ready to turn.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell drivers about upcoming road conditions. This sign tells you that the right lane is ending. Be ready for traffic to merge.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell you what you must and must not do. This sign means U-turns are not allowed wherever it is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay to the right side of the divider ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. Round signs warn only about railroad crossings ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a one-way road. If you see this sign facing you, traffic is coming toward you. Do not enter. Turn around.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep hill or downgrade ahead. The hill may be long, steep, or have sharp curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The highway ahead curves only to the right.
The highway ahead turns sharply to the right.
The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
The highway ahead curves to the left and then to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about road hazards ahead. This sign warns that the road curves right and then left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you about upcoming conditions. This sign warns that a side road is joining ahead. Stay alert.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An octagonal sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop. Stop at the marked line or before the crosswalk. If there is no crosswalk, stop at a point where you can see traffic coming.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Drivers can use hand signals instead of or with their turn signals. When a driver extends their left arm straight out to the side, it means they are turning left or changing lanes to the left.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They warn drivers about upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign tells drivers to watch for bicycles crossing the road.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Cars on the right move first.
Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.
questions.explanation: This sign means you must yield. Slow down and let other vehicles and pedestrians in front of you pass first. Stop if needed before you go ahead.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: You must bear either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a Y intersection ahead. You must choose to go either right or left.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: A round yellow sign warns that a railroad crossing is coming up.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They warn drivers about upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns that an intersection is coming up.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield to trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield to trains.
questions.explanation: A round sign means a railroad crossing is ahead. This sign is posted a few hundred feet before the tracks. It tells you to slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic moving the same direction will soon become one lane.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign marks a crosswalk. Watch for pedestrians who may be crossing the road.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the overpass ahead has low clearance. Do not go through if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign (in this case, 13 feet 6 inches).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black symbols. This sign warns you that the right lane will end ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert drivers to road conditions ahead. This sign warns you to watch for people crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert drivers to upcoming conditions. This sign warns you that bicycles may cross the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
The road ahead turns sharply left, then right.
The road ahead curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road will turn sharply to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: What is the main concern when you see this sign?

options.text: Driving with your headlights out of alignment because one side of your car is higher than the other.
Damaging a tire from drifting onto the shoulder.
Hydroplaning, if the shoulder has water on it.
Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the shoulder is lower than the road. If one wheel drops onto the low shoulder, do not brake hard or steer sharply. This can cause you to lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: What does an orange sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs mark construction areas. Drive carefully and watch for workers and equipment.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic in the lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
Lanes are reserved for buses and vehicles with a driver and one or more passengers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved only for people with disabled parking permits.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars in right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes moving in the same direction will become one lane ahead. Be ready to merge.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This one-way sign means traffic can only move in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red and white triangular sign means you must yield the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign warns drivers that a steep hill is coming. Slow down to protect your brakes and avoid accidents.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes very slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an intersection is ahead. A road joins from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can travel in either direction in this lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns of two-way traffic.

questions.question: This white sign means you should not pass other vehicles:

options.text: Until after you pass the sign.

questions.explanation: White rectangular signs show rules you must obey. This sign means you cannot pass other vehicles under any circumstances.

questions.question: What message appears on a red octagon-shaped sign?
questions.explanation: An octagon-shaped sign always means "stop." You must come to a complete stop at this sign.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must turn either right or left.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must turn either right or left.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign warns that the road splits and you must choose to go either right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits right turns. Do not turn right at an intersection with this sign.

questions.question: What message appears on this yellow pennant-shaped sign?
questions.explanation: Yellow pennant-shaped signs mark a no passing zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A sharp turn is ahead. Slow down.

questions.correctAnswerText: A sharp turn is ahead. Slow down.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about road conditions ahead. This sign warns that a sharp turn is coming. You should slow down.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down when the road is wet.
The road ahead has curves or turns.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down when the road is wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. Reduce your speed, avoid sudden braking or turns, and stay farther away from the vehicle ahead of you.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs mean you must stop. You must yield to other traffic. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It means you cannot drive in your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red line through it means something is not allowed. Right turns are forbidden where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions ahead. This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about road conditions ahead. This sign tells you to be careful when the road is wet and slippery.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A bicycle repair shop is ahead.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that bicycles may be in the area.

questions.question: What can you do from the center lane?
questions.explanation: This lane is only for left turns. You cannot use it to pass other vehicles or to drive straight through.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down; the road curves ahead.
Slow down and do not use your brakes.
Slow down; the road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down; the road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Watch for traffic merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for traffic merging from the right.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that traffic may merge into your lane from the right.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that an intersection is coming. Watch carefully for traffic crossing your path.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people crossing your path.

questions.explanation: This orange warning sign means road work is coming. Stay alert for temporary traffic control devices when driving through a work zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a yield sign is coming. Start slowing down when you see this warning sign.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: An upcoming curve in the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming curve in the road.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead curves to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash through it means the action is prohibited. U-turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign is posted on one-way streets and roads you cannot enter. You may see this sign if you try to enter an expressway ramp going the wrong way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Change in direction or narrowing of roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change in direction or narrowing of roadway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road direction is changing or the road is getting narrower. You may see these signs on sharp curves or approaches to narrow bridges.

questions.question: What does this sign show about the road ahead?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a reverse curve. The road curves right, then curves left.

questions.question: What is this symbol used for?
questions.explanation: A reflective orange triangle on the back of a vehicle means it moves slowly. You may see this on farm equipment, roadwork vehicles, or horse-drawn wagons. During the day it looks like an orange triangle. At night it looks like a hollow red triangle.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are entering a one-way street in the wrong direction.
Do not drive in this lane.
Left-turning traffic on a green light must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Left-turning traffic on a green light must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign works with a traffic light. It tells drivers that vehicles turning left do not have the right-of-way. They must wait for oncoming traffic to pass.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed on slow-moving vehicles.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Sharp turn to the right ahead.
Upcoming sharp left and right turns.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the road ahead has curves. Slow down as needed.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?

options.text: There is a sharp turn to the right.
A right turn is permitted on a green arrow only.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a sharp turn to the right.
questions.explanation: Some warning signs have a fluorescent yellow-green background. These signs warn you about upcoming road conditions, including curves and sharp turns.

questions.question: What does this white sign mean?

options.text: The railroad crossing is controlled. Continue at your regular speed.
Look, listen, and be ready to stop if necessary.
Stop at the railroad tracks and wait for a signal before crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look, listen, and be ready to stop if necessary.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing, you must look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop. Wait for any trains to pass before you cross.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic signal ahead is showing red.
The traffic signal ahead is broken.
The traffic signal ahead is showing green.
There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that there is a traffic signal at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: The right lane ends. Traffic must merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane ends. Traffic must merge left.
questions.explanation: This sign means the right lane on a multilane road is ending. Traffic in the right lane must move to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is approaching.
Look both ways as you cross the intersection.
Always come to a full stop at the intersection.
Slow down and be ready to stop if necessary.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be ready to stop if necessary.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you approach a yield sign. Be ready to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians pass. Stop completely if traffic requires it.

questions.question: What should you do at this red and white sign?

options.text: Stop and check for traffic from both directions before proceeding.
Give the right-of-way to traffic on the road you wish to enter or cross.
Keep a steady speed and check for traffic from all directions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Give the right-of-way to traffic on the road you wish to enter or cross.
questions.explanation: A three-sided yield sign means slow down and be ready to stop if needed. Let any vehicles, bicyclists, or pedestrians pass before you proceed. You do not have the right-of-way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road is slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road curves ahead.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you should:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a divided highway is starting. Stay to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means the road ahead is now divided. Stay to the right of the divider.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right. You must obey this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a flagger is ahead controlling traffic in a work zone.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
There are a series of curves ahead.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: There are a series of curves ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of multiple curves coming up on the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means the right lane is ending. Drivers in that lane must move to another lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that a curve is coming. Warning signs are yellow with black markings.

questions.question: On the freeway, you see a "Merging traffic" sign. What should you do?

options.text: Always remain at your present speed.
Speed up to avoid congesting traffic.
Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.
